column1: # CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor, 12 logical, 3593 MHz
# Mode: Editor EditMode test runner, batchmode=True

# Runtime scope: Stage 04.1 (#58): clock + lifecycle + commands + CombatActionSystem + CombatFacingSystem + CombatMovementSystem + CombatSpatialIndexSystem + CombatHitSystem; not the historical Stage 01 baseline
# Numerical kernel is Schedule+Complete; movement includes main-thread gather/write and job dispatch. Kernel flag reports actual managed execution, never assumes Burst.
# Cold means first Movement in a new World; Burst may already be compiled by earlier tests.
# Dense work is not linear. Native capacity is payload lower bound. Full fixed group measured separately.
# #69 native columns (Profiler.GetTotalAllocatedMemoryLong, process-wide, NOT a leak test by itself): native_owner_profiler_on = the measured owner loop with the Profiler enabled (GC.Alloc recorder);
#   native_compare_pass = the following test-only scan/index comparison pass; native_owner_profiler_off = another owner pass with the Profiler disabled;
#   native_after_dispose = after World disposal minus before World creation (test-side scratch of this scenario is still alive, ~100 KB).

# #69 contact velocity: velocity_contacts = recorded contact pairs summed over measured ticks; velocity_passes_max = the largest per-tick pass count; velocity_residual_max = the largest last-pass change (u/s; > 1e-5 means the pass cap was reached).
# Stage 04.4/04.5 (#66): impulses every 30 ticks (single = controlled fighter, mass = everyone); strikes = presses every 30 ticks.
# Hit search: the same final snapshot and Active attackers, complete scan vs index batch (+Inside kernel); counts must match. Overlapping timings are not additive.
